# libs/bonnie — CLAUDE.md

Angular rendering library (`@candy-kingdom/bonnie`). See the root `CLAUDE.md` for full project context.

## Critical rule

**Never edit `src/lib/generated/`** — files there are auto-generated by `apps/marcy-gen` from C# source. Run `dotnet run --project apps/marcy-gen` to regenerate.

## Public API

Everything exported from `src/index.ts` is the public API. The barrel re-exports entire sub-folders:

```
src/index.ts
  └── export * from "./lib/core"
  └── export * from "./lib/generated"
  └── export * from "./lib/localization"
  └── export * from "./lib/marcy-image"
  └── export * from "./lib/marcy-media"
  └── export * from "./lib/marcy-video"
  └── export * from "./lib/skeleton"
```

Each sub-folder has its own `index.ts` barrel. When adding a new export, add it to the **sub-folder's `index.ts`** — the root barrel picks it up automatically.

## Adding a new component or directive

1. Create the file inside the relevant sub-folder (or a new sub-folder under `src/lib/`).
2. Export it from that sub-folder's `index.ts`.
3. If it's a new sub-folder, add `export * from "./lib/<folder>"` to `src/index.ts`.

## Signals pattern

This library uses Angular signals exclusively — no `@Input()` / `@Output()` decorators:

```typescript
// Inputs
readonly src = input<Image | undefined>();

// Outputs
readonly clicked = output<void>();

// Two-way (model)
readonly value = model<string>('');

// Internal state
readonly isVisible = signal(false);
readonly derived = computed(() => this.src()?.sources.length ?? 0);
```

Templates must call signals to unwrap: `{{ src()?.sources }}`, `@if (isVisible())`.

## Bone components

Bone components receive data through `BoneDirective` as a host directive:

```typescript
@Component({
  selector: 'app-my-bone',
  hostDirectives: [{ directive: BoneDirective, inputs: ['bone'] }],
})
export class MyBoneComponent implements IBoneComponent {
  readonly bd = inject(BoneDirective<MyBone>);
  // template: bd.bone().title | localize
}
```

## SSR guard pattern

Any code that accesses browser APIs must guard for SSR:

```typescript
const deviceService = inject(DeviceService);

if (!deviceService.isSSR) {
  // browser-only code
}
```

Or use `typeof window === 'undefined'` directly in edge cases.

## Control flow

Use `@if` / `@for` — never `*ngIf` / `*ngFor`:

```html
@if (src()) {
  <bon-image />
}
@for (item of items(); track item.id) {
  <span>{{ item.label }}</span>
}
```

## Build

```bash
npx nx build bonnie
npx nx lint bonnie
```
